conclusion.scope: exact H=100 necessary-packet screen for 19 coefficients and complete realization/acuteness of the first two packets of the selected 2theta lane; later walls remain open

local_arithmetic.manifest_scope: all squarefree support products generated by inert (2), discriminant (3), ramified (2-theta), and at most one of the three primes above 13, radical norm at most 351
local_arithmetic.proof: For primitive r=(x,y), q(r) divides 2I(r), with I(r)=(a*x,(y,K12^2)).  The Smith form of K12^2 is 1^12,3^12. Away from (2),(3) and the squarefree support of a, primitivity forces zero norm valuation.  At an odd coefficient prime P the valuation is zero or one, and the positive case forces y in P*K12^2.  At (3) the valuation is zero or one and the positive case forces all spatial pairings to be divisible by 3.  At inert (2), evenness gives valuation zero or one for odd a and exactly one when v_2(a)=1.  Class number one and U^+=U^2 give the canonical products used below.
